meta.name: parcel-compactor
meta.description: Strips intermediate debate, resolved critiques, and redundant commentary from a merged parcel plan (v1.1_merged.md), outputting a lean, noise-free execution specification (v2.0_approved.md) for the blind executor.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 精简计划文档,输出无冗余的执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果讨论稿冗长,想要一份干净的执行清单。
copy.tagline_en: Condense debate-heavy plans into clean execution specs
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need a clean spec from a messy planning document.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会把合并后的计划文件（v1.1_merged.md）压缩成精简执行规格（v2.0_approved.md）。它会删除讨论、批评、勾选清单等非指令内容，只保留意图、范围、执行指令、待办和测试计划，并记录压缩日志。
howto.when: 所有评审合并进 v1.1_merged.md 之后，进入执行阶段前触发。

say.text: 把 v1.1_merged.md 压缩成 v2.0_approved.md。
say.note: 生成精简执行规格并写入决策日志。

say.text: 用 parcel-compactor 清理当前合并计划。
say.note: 删除讨论噪音，只留执行指令。

say.text: 对计划文件执行压缩，去掉所有评审评论。

howto.what_en: Claude compresses merged plan v1.1_merged.md into clean execution spec v2.0_approved.md by removing debate, critiques, and checklists, keeping only directives, to-dos, and tests, and logs the compaction.
howto.when_en: Triggers in the pass-the-parcel pipeline after all reviews are merged into v1.1_merged.md and before the execution phase.

say_en.note: Produces lean execution spec and logs.

say_en.text: Run parcel-compactor on the current merged plan.
Compact the plan file, removing review commentary.
